_readme: Per-dish crop overrides for scripts/assets.ts. Key = photo name in ../img. position: attention | entropy | centre | north | south | east | west | northeast | northwest | southeast | southwest. x / y (0..1) place the focal point inside the region and win over position. inset (px, default 16) trims every edge first. left / top / width / height (source px) extract a region instead of the inset. why: free text. Dishes without an entry use the attention strategy.

corn-fritters.why: Attention dropped to the bowl base and table and cut the top of the fritter stack; centre on the stack.

fried-avocado.why: Attention dropped low and let the hand holding the tray (bottom-left, below y 700) into the corner while cutting the top sticks; extract above the hand and keep the whole pile.

garlic-confit.why: Attention cut the front bulb in half. Keep the back bulb whole and let the front one bleed off the left edge; trim the page-paper hairline on the top and left.

greenbean-peas.why: Attention slid right and clipped the salad; centre on the bowl.

grilled-fish.why: Attention framed a close-up of the skin and dip cup and lost the head; keep the whole fish head-first and stop short of the dip cup.

mini-broccoli.why: Attention kept the stalk ends and cut the florets; the source has no paper edge, so use its full width and keep the florets.

mushrooms.why: Handwritten menu lettering along the bottom edge and a page-paper strip on the left; extract above and inside them.

nashville-chicken.why: Centring the chicken sliced the dip cup in half. Pin the frame to the top so the dip and pickles stay whole, and trim only the page-paper strip on the right edge.

river-prawns.why: Attention kept the empty plate rim and cut off the prawn head; centre on the prawn from tail to head.

striploin.why: Attention cut the end slice off; start the frame at the first slice.

tiramisu.why: Attention framed the empty table on the left and clipped the glass; centre on the glass.

tomato-salad.why: Attention cut the bowl rim at the top; keep the rim and lose a little of the base.

wagyu-tenderloin.why: Attention sliced the left medallion in half; centre on the rosemary so both pieces read.
